introduction: WOOKTOOL custom logo tape measures support importers, distributors and private-label brands that need a measurable product specification alongside consistent logo and packaging presentation. Buyers can start from an existing model and define the elements that matter for their market.

Customization can include the case logo, shell color, metric or imperial scale, blade marking direction, hook, lanyard, belt clip, barcode label, retail artwork and carton mark. Artwork and sample approval should be completed before bulk production is released.
For a practical quote, send the preferred model or reference photo, expected quantity, target market, logo file, packaging style, scale requirement and requested delivery timing.

faq.question: Where can a logo be placed on a tape measure?
faq.answer: Logo placement can be reviewed on the case label, shell or selected packaging surfaces according to the model structure and artwork requirements.

faq.question: Can the blade use a custom metric or inch scale?
faq.answer: Metric, imperial and dual-scale directions can be discussed for the selected model. Confirm the target market and required units in the RFQ.

faq.question: What files are useful for custom tape measure artwork?
faq.answer: Provide the logo in a usable vector or high-resolution format where possible, plus Pantone references, packaging dielines or reference images if available.

faq.question: Do custom logo tape measures require sample approval?
faq.answer: Sample approval is recommended when the project includes new artwork, color matching, blade layout or retail packaging requirements.

faq.question: Can barcode labels and carton marks be customized?
faq.answer: Yes. Barcode labels, carton marks and retail packaging information can be reviewed as part of the private-label packaging specification.
